title: jovellana repens
intro: Jovellana repens, commonly known as New Zealand groundsel, is a plant native to the South Island of New Zealand and is a member of the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Jovellana repens include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, as well as its potential to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Jovellana repens include sesquiterpene lactones and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
